messages:
Sam K: Hey team, I'm Sam — first week on infra. Trying to link our GCP project to billing and I also don't see the AWS dev account in my console. Who should I ping for permissions? :wave:
Devon (infra): Welcome Sam! For GCP: you need permission on the billing account and on the project. Billing side usually needs Billing Account Viewer + Billing Account User (to attach projects). Project side needs Billing Project Manager / Project Owner to change billing. Which billing account ID are you trying to use?
Sam K: billing account id: 0123-ABCD-4567. I ran the gcloud command and got a permission error:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.beta.billing.projects.link) permission denied: billing.resourceAssociations.create
```
Alex - IT: For AWS — do you have the AWS SSO assignment? If you log into Okta and then the AWS SSO portal you should see account list. If the dev account isn't listed I can add you to the devs-sso group which gives console assume-role access. If you need IAM role creation rights, that's a separate request (we avoid granting admin by default).
Sam K: I do SSO into Okta but only see prod-account and infra-ops, not dev. Can you add me to devs-sso @Alex?
Alex - IT: Yep, filing the SSO group add. Should be done in ~30m. I also confirmed we keep us-central1 and europe-west1 whitelisted; if you need other regions for testing let me know and we can update permission set to include them.
Devon (infra): Sam, I'll try to attach the billing account from infra side — sometimes the org-level policy blocks project linking. Quick checklist:
- Make sure `billing.googleapis.com` API is enabled on the project
- Project needs `roles/resourcemanager.projectMover` or project owner to change billing
- Billing account must allow IAM member (billing account user)
If you can paste the project id I'll try.
Sam K: thanks — project id: redwood-dev-mltest
Maria L: welcome Sam! FYI onboarding doc: https://redwood/handbook/onboarding/cloud-access (has checklist). Also for GCP project linking we usually ask engineers to request a "Project Billing Link" ticket so infra can audit. :memo:
cloud-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0153 — label: infra, assignee: Devon (infra)
Sam K: awesome — pasted logs above and I'll wait. If you need me to run any gcloud commands I can.
Devon (infra): Got it, starting the audit now. I'll post back when it's linked or if we need a pm/owner to grant project-side permission. :thumbsup:
Sam K: thanks everyone :pray:
